title: dryopteris subarborea
intro: Dryopteris subarborea, commonly known as Autumn fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. It is a medicinal plant used for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and inflammation, due to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris subarborea include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in preventing chronic diseases.
